title: Spot Show demo
description: A card/block visual report rendered by Spot and refreshed on redeploy.

cards.title: What Spot Show is
cards.summary: Agents write this JSON instead of hand-authoring a whole page.

blocks.title: Summary
blocks.body:
## Agent visual report
- One site name acts like a session
- Cards group focused ideas
- Blocks render prose, diagrams, diffs, logs, data, and demos
- Redeploying refreshes open browser tabs

blocks.title: Workflow
blocks.body:
flowchart LR
  A[Agent] --> B[show.json]
  B --> C[spot show deploy]
  C --> D[Spot site]
  D --> E[Browser refresh]
